reuse.why: Changes only the existing getWorstCaseAmount/getApproxWorstCaseAmount helpers, which getPlannedAmount/getScheduledAmount route through, and keeps getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Nothing is duplicated; both helpers become single expressions.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the planned-amount helpers live.

scope.why: Only the two helpers, their comment, tests, and the existing release note are updated.

maintainability.why: Math.min and value - tolerance express 'the least money in' directly, with an explanatory comment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planned amounts flow through getScheduledAmount and the two changed helpers
